Source and redaction notes for tests/fixtures/watchdog/claude/*.jsonl (T005).

Source: a real ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl transcript
for this repo's own session-watchdog planning/implementation session
(sessionId 381af3ca-21cf-4e03-88e3-1166fe571ef2, this repo's worktree project
slug), captured 2026-07-10.

Real, unmodified fields carried into the fixtures: top-level record shape
(parentUuid/isSidechain/type/message/uuid/timestamp/sessionId/cwd), the
`message.usage` object's shape and the four numeric fields the adapter reads
(input_tokens/cache_creation_input_tokens/cache_read_input_tokens/
output_tokens) — every usage number below is copied verbatim from a real
line in that transcript:

- transcript_nominal.jsonl line 3 (uuid a-0001): real line 13
  (input=17809, cache_creation=11121, cache_read=25725, output=255).
- transcript_nominal.jsonl line 5 (uuid a-0002): real line 39/40
  (input=2, cache_creation=826, cache_read=173301, output=1115).
- transcript_appended_lines.jsonl (uuid a-0003): real line 244
  (input=131, cache_creation=2296, cache_read=261843, output=2451) — the
  latest usage line seen in that transcript's growth, used here to represent
  a subsequent turn appended after the initial read.
- transcript_malformed_tail.jsonl line 3 (uuid a-0001): same real line 13
  values as above, followed by a deliberately-truncated 4th line (valid JSON
  up through the `usage` object's opening bytes, no closing braces, no
  trailing newline) simulating a write flushed mid-append.

Redactions applied (no real prompt/response content or account identifiers
are present in these fixtures): `message.content` text replaced with
generic placeholders (`<redacted user prompt>`, `<redacted response>`,
`<redacted tool result>`); the real `thinking` signature blob and
`requestId`/`version`/`gitBranch`/`entrypoint`/`userType` fields (not needed
by the adapter) are dropped entirely; `uuid`/`sessionId` values are replaced
with synthetic sequential ids (`u-000N`/`a-000N`/`test-session-000N`).

prompt_ready_pane_statusline_footer.txt: captured live 2026-07-11 via
`tmux capture-pane -p` from a real idle Claude Code session (Opus 4.8 UI):
the composer glyph sits 4 non-blank lines above the pane bottom because the
statusline footer (separator + model line + auto-mode line) renders below it.
Regression fixture for the _prompt_glyph_ready window widening.
